fields.title: Reference column
fields.description: Column with the correct, observed, training data values.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Predicted column
fields.description: Column with the modeled, predicted data values.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Override output column name
fields.description: Overrides the name of the column in the output. By default, the name of the predicted column is used.

fields.title: Output column name
fields.description: The name of the column in the output.

fields.title: Export and prefix flow variables
fields.description:
If enabled, the scores will be exported as flow variables with hard coded names and prefixed by the given
value.

fields.title: Number of predictors
fields.description:
The number of predictors used to compute the adjusted R squared. The adjusted R squared is calculated as:
1 - ((1 - R²) * (n - 1)) / (n - p - 1), where n is the number of observations and p is the number of
predictors.
